articles.summary: New York, NY, December 11, 2025/PRNewswire – Lument Finance Trust, Inc. (NYSE: LFT) (“LFT” or the “Company”) announced the declaration of a cash dividend of $0.04 per share of common stock with respect to the fourth quarter of 2025. The dividend is payable on January 15, 2026, to common stockholders of record as of the close of business
articles.title: Lument Finance Trust, Inc. Declares Quarterly Cash Dividends for its Common and Preferred Stock
